name: silver-pack
_comment: restyle-back.cjs: the 151 back restyled to a graded front. Only the colours are per pack; the film level, sheen, grain and chroma are measured from the front by the tool.

palette._source: silver-pack-front.webp. metal = median of the brightest 30% of the tier lettering box (150-780 x 1270-1366); pale = median of the brightest 25% of the logo box (310-580 x 600-885); dark = median of the darkest 10% of the body

_seamFlatten: Silver's crimp carries big reflection spots that repeated along the fin; the fin takes each crimp row's median instead.
